topics.topic: The Monarchy in Israel: Demand for a king and Saul's disobedience
learningObjectives: Analyze Israel's motives for demanding a human king like neighboring nations
Explain Samuel's solemn warning on royal taxation, conscription, and oppression
Examine Saul's anointing, early victories, and subsequent disobedience at Gilgal and against the Amalekites

topics.topic: The Reign of David: A man after God's own heart, triumphs, sin, and repentance
learningObjectives: Trace David's anointing by Samuel, victory over Goliath, and ascension to the throne in Hebron
Analyze David's submission to divine authority and refusal to harm Saul
Examine David's adultery with Bathsheba, Nathan's parable of the ewe lamb, and genuine repentance (Psalm 51)

topics.topic: The Wisdom of Solomon: Building the Temple and royal apostasy
learningObjectives: Describe Solomon’s prayer for an understanding heart at Gibeon (1 Kings 3)
Analyze the wise judgment between the two mothers claiming the living child
Trace the building and dedication of the Jerusalem Temple, foreign marriages, and descent into idolatry

topics.topic: The Division of the Kingdom: Rehoboam's folly and Jeroboam's rebellion
learningObjectives: Examine the petition of the northern tribes for tax relief following Solomon’s death
Contrast Rehoboam's rejection of elderly counsel with his acceptance of youth advice
Analyze the secession of the ten northern tribes under Jeroboam and the golden calves at Bethel and Dan

topics.topic: Religious Tension in Israel: Elijah on Mount Carmel and the contest with Baal prophets
learningObjectives: Trace King Ahab and Jezebel's introduction of Phoenician Baal worship in Israel
Analyze Elijah’s proclamation of drought and the drought's devastating impact
Describe the contest on Mount Carmel (1 Kings 18) and the triumphant revelation of Yahweh as true God

topics.topic: Greed and Abuse of Power: The story of Naboth’s vineyard and divine judgment
learningObjectives: Examine Ahab's covetousness of Naboth’s ancestral vineyard and Naboth's refusal to sell
Analyze Jezebel’s fraudulent judicial conspiracy leading to Naboth’s stoning
Examine Elijah’s confrontation with Ahab and the solemn prophecy of divine retribution against the house of Omri

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Old Testament Kings Clinic
learningObjectives: Assess pupil mastery of the united and divided monarchy of Israel
Conduct textual analysis of 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 1 Kings
Provide remedial guidance on comparing leadership virtues of David versus Solomon

topics.topic: Religious Reforms in Judah: King Josiah's discovery of the Book of the Law
learningObjectives: Describe the moral decadence of Judah under Manasseh and Amon
Detail the discovery of the Book of the Law during temple repairs in Josiah’s eighteenth year (2 Kings 22)
Examine Josiah’s sweeping national reforms: demolishing high places, reviving the Passover feast

topics.topic: Concern for One's Nation: Nehemiah and the rebuilding of the broken walls of Jerusalem
learningObjectives: Examine Nehemiah's reaction to the distressing report of Jerusalem's ruin while cupbearer in Susa
Analyze Nehemiah's prayer, strategic planning, and secret night inspection of the broken walls
Demonstrate how Nehemiah overcame external opposition (Sanballat, Tobiah) and finished the walls in 52 days

topics.topic: Faith in Times of Trial: Shadrach, Meshach, Abednego, and Daniel in Babylon
learningObjectives: Analyze the refusal of the three Hebrew youths to worship Nebuchadnezzar's golden image
Examine divine deliverance from the burning fiery furnace (Daniel 3)
Trace Daniel's unwavering prayer life and deliverance from the lions' den under King Darius (Daniel 6)

topics.topic: The Parables of Jesus on the Kingdom of God and Forgiveness
learningObjectives: Define a parable as an earthly story with a heavenly meaning
Examine the Parable of the Sower, Wheat and Tares, and Mustard Seed regarding the Kingdom of God
Analyze the Parable of the Unmerciful Servant and Prodigal Son highlighting grace and mutual forgiveness

topics.topic: Comprehensive Termly CRS Revision & WASSCE Mock Essay Seminar
learningObjectives: Consolidate learning across Old Testament history and Christ’s parables
Practice timed essay writing answering past WASSCE Paper 2 section A and section B questions
Reinforce analytical writing linking biblical leadership to contemporary Nigerian governance
Administer official SSS 2 CRS end-of-term theory and objective examination
Grade student answer scripts in accordance with WAEC standardized scoring keys
Record and publish official broadsheet marks for termly student assessments
